title: The Thorn of the Ninefold Court Again
author: Freya Vasquez
blurb: Wren Voss, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
